name: Los Blázquez (Spain)
description: Quartered white and blue with a yellow bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Los Blázquez (a tree on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Los Blázquez; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
